en: Black‑and‑white image of an early 20th‑century steam cargo/passenger ship moving along a harbor or river. The vessel has a dark hull, a single tall funnel, and cargo masts with booms. Behind the ship is a dense waterfront of low-rise row houses, warehouses, chimneys, and cranes, suggesting an industrial European port city. The photo has the framing and tonal style typical of vintage maritime postcards.
